# USB Forge boot menu theme (GRUB gfxmenu). Colours match src/theme.rs.
# Images are generated by make-theme.ps1. Layout follows the boot loader's stock theme so its
# hotkey and boot-mode hints (the @VTOY_*@ labels) keep working.

desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-color: "#0f1117"
title-text: " "
title-color: "#e6e8ee"
message-color: "#e6e8ee"

terminal-box: "terminal_box_*.png"

+ boot_menu {
  left = 15%
  width = 70%
  top = 30%
  height = 52%

  menu_pixmap_style = "menu_*.png"

  item_color = "#e6e8ee"
  item_height = 32
  item_spacing = 2
  item_padding = 6

  selected_item_color = "#ff7a45"
  selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"

  item_icon_space = 0

  scrollbar = true
  scrollbar_width = 10
  scrollbar_thumb = "slider_*.png"
}

+ progress_bar {
  id = "__timeout__"
  text = "@TIMEOUT_NOTIFICATION_LONG@"

  left = 15%
  width = 70%
  top = 84%
  height = 20

  text_color = "#8b93a7"
  fg_color = "#5a2e1c"
  bg_color = "#151821"
  border_color = "#2a303e"
}
